name: opencode-automode
description: Local auto mode for opencode 2.x permissions: Pi rules, Kev on llama.cpp, Landlock write sandbox.

scripts.build:sandbox: cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path sandbox/lockwrite-rs/Cargo.toml && cp sandbox/lockwrite-rs/target/release/lockwrite sandbox/lockwrite && mkdir -p sandbox/bin && for s in bash zsh sh; do ln -sf ../lockwrite sandbox/bin/$s; done && sandbox/lockwrite --selftest
